title: Allah Muje Lashkare mehdi se mila de
body:
Allah Muje Lashkare mehdi se mila de
Allah mujhe lashkar e mehdi se mila de
Allah mujhe lashkar e mehdi se mila
de...AMEEN
<<DIVIDER>>
Aisa na ho aaka mera halmin ki sada
de
nazro ko meri layake didar bana de
parda jo pada he meri ankho pe utha
de
hadi e zama karo pe purnur dikha de
<<MINI>>
Allah mujhe lashkar e mehdi se mila de
Allah mujhe lashkar e mehdi se mila
de...AMEEN
<<DIVIDER>>
har ek nisha ko pro zalalat ka mita du
har rah me ek dip sadaqat ka jala du
iss khair e amal ki mujhe taufeek
khuda de
<<MINI>>
Allah mujhe lashkar e mehdi se mila
de...AMEEN
<<DIVIDER>>
likh de meri taqdeer me maula ki
ghulami
hasil mujhe ho jaye ye ezaz dawami
har khwaish e duniya ko mere dil se
mita de
<<MINI>>
Allah mujhe lashkar e mehdi se mila
de...AMEEN
<<DIVIDER>>
shamil rahe lehje me sada har pe
sadaqat
shamshir tale me bhi karo koi ibadat
ay kash mujhe fatima zehra ye dua de
<<MINI>>
Allah mujhe lashkar e mehdi se mila
de...AMEEN
<<DIVIDER>>
shabbir ke ansar me shamil ho mera
naam
jo hur ka ho mehshar me wohi ho
mera anjaam
kha ke kadam e hazrat shabbir bana
de
<<MINI>>
Allah mujhe lashkar e mehdi se mila
de...AMEEN
<<DIVIDER>>
dekhu na agar uthte huwe parda e
ghaibat
aye jo mere baad yaha hazrat e hujjat
turbat me abad ko mera shaana hila
de
<<MINI>>
Allah mujhe lashkar e mehdi se mila
de...AMEEN
author: Ali Safdar
